test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT true?

options.text: Tao Ying was travelling with her son.
Twenty cents was a sum that mattered to Tao Ying.
Tao Ying boarded the bus after her son.
Tao Ying actually needed to buy two tickets.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Tao Ying actually needed to buy two tickets.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first sentence of the second paragraph says "*Today **she is with her son** Xiao Ye*'' (दूसरे पैराग्राफ का पहला वाक्य कहता है, आज वह अपने बेटे Xiao Ye के साथ है), the second sentence of the second paragraph says "***She follows him onto the bus***'' (दूसरे पैराग्राफ का दूसरा वाक्य कहता है कि वह बस में उसका पीछा करती है) and the sixth sentence of the third paragraph says ''***Twenty cents is not to be scoffed at***''. (तीसरे पैराग्राफ का छठा वाक्य कहता है, बीस सेंट का उपहास नहीं करना चाहिए)
 
• From the above sentences, we can say that the statement in the fourth option is NOT true. (उपरोक्त वाक्यों से हम कह सकते हैं कि चौथे विकल्प में दिया गया कथन सत्य नहीं है)

 

Hence, the only possible answer is option 4.

64:Taea,

The correct answer is '**wanted to feel like a grown-up**.'
